week_story: Flavor-Wrapped more than doubled to $40,064 (+124%): the Microwave Popcorn Kit rose 157% to $24,508 and Butter Luxe rose to $3,338 from $891.
The Silicone Popper rose 122% to $11,252. The Gift Set 12-Pack fell to $480 from $12,621 because it is out of stock.
Sales stepped up from Thursday: $10.1K–$12.8K a day vs $6.0K–$6.8K Mon–Wed, as daily ad spend roughly tripled.
refunds: Refund money was $802 vs $942 last week; the refund rate fell to 1.8% from 3.7%.
Refunded units fell to 42 from 54 while orders rose 59%.
pacing_reco: November is $172,572 through Nov 22, 18% behind the same days last year ($209,635) and pacing to about $235.3K; keeping the Kit and Popper in stock through BF/CM is the biggest lever.
ads_context: Ad spend doubled to $7,607 (+102%) and ad sales doubled to $28,709, so ACoS held at 26.5%.
TACoS rose to 11.6% from 8.1%; ads drove 44% of sales at a 3.8 ROAS.
